description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

VTG is seeking an Associate Software Engineer to support software for modeling acoustic beampatterns for submarine sonar arrays. The role focuses on developing and maintaining front-end/backend interfaces, improving software performance and architecture for scalability and parallel execution, configuring GPU support, and communicating requirements with cross-company partners.
Software engineer building and maintaining backend interfaces, improving system architecture and performance

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain interfaces as the backend tool scales and evolves
• SW performance and architecture updates
• Communicate requirements and interface definitions clearly with cross-company partners

Requirements:
• Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or similar
• Proficient with Python
• Proficient with RESTful/gRPC
• Experience with Linux systems
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Initiative, innovation, and resourcefulness
• Must be a US Citizen with current DoD Secret Clearance

Preferred:
• One+ years relevant specifically experience with SQL or NoSQL
• Knowledgeable with modern PaaS environment tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Podman, KVM, and Helm
• Experience with CuPy or Numba for writing GPU kernels in Python
• Experience with Python's multiprocessing library
• Experience with shell scripting languages
